evidence:
Source review of every criterion in both gates and the functional and polish suites; I found no reject/hide/absent/unchanged leg that a blank, dead or login-only app could earn by absence. Not measured: no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so whether the judge actually performs each control is NOT EXERCISED; the scripted golden results (all criteria true in runtime.json, editor.json, polish.json) only show the golden satisfies the scripted versions.

Global rule: task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:14 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails rather than passing on absence of evidence.' and prompt.md:9 'If you did not perform a step, that step did not pass.' tests/app_context.md:29 'a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work.'

Per-criterion pairing inside the same criterion (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml):
- cw_format_error_keeps_draft (l.209): 'First format a small valid JavaScript draft ... and see it change, as the working control' ... 'Fails ... if the valid control did not format.'
- cw_error_message_and_line (l.236): 'First ... run a small valid JavaScript draft as the working control'; unchanged-draft leg paired with 'a visible error must be shown'.
- cw_run_starts_fresh_document (l.263): 'Confirm the first marker is shown and that the first run reports the property as defined: this is the working control'; second run must also show its own marker.
- cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget (l.281): the first button's delayed marker is 'the working control that an interaction after the run gets its own time'; the second leg requires a visible time-limit reason (a positive observation).
- cw_time_limit_recovery (l.299): control run plus 'a final valid Run must show its own new output'.
- cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (l.308): control draft's marker must appear from timer, interval and Promise; 'Fails ... if the control marker never appeared'; void-attempt handling fails rather than passes.
- cw_newer_run_supersedes (l.317): 4-second delayed control marker, new marker must appear, 'Fails ... if the control marker never appeared'.
- cw_preview_isolation (l.326): saved snippet, health address in a normal tab and a localStorage round trip 'as working controls'; own-preview DOM and log 'both must work'; 'treat a probe that stays silent as not performed, which fails this criterion'.
- cw_dynamic_code_refused (l.335): harmless strings-and-comments draft 'must run normally and log the marker, as the working control'; each refusal needs 'a visible reason'; 'Fails ... if any is refused silently, or if the harmless control draft is refused.'
- cw_stale_save_refused (l.353): 'this accepted Save is the working control' ... 'or if A's control Save did not succeed'.
- cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (l.362): 'First confirm the working control: a fresh read ... shows A's values and none of B's'; B's draft must also accept one more typed character.
- cw_history_restore_retry (l.371): the 'no fifth revision' leg follows a restore that must first create a fourth revision; the second-tab leg needs the fifth revision's source still listed.
- cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (l.389): 'If A's library never shows B's snippet, this criterion fails as well because the situation could not be produced.'
- cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (l.398): baseline 'A shows no notice ... yet' is paired with the notice appearing after B's Save; the draft-kept leg is paired with that notice.
- cw_find_forward_backward_wrap / cw_replace_all_atomic (l.137, l.155): near-match 'never visited' / 'unchanged' legs sit beside three and four real matches that must be visited or replaced; the Redo-cleared leg follows a Redo that had to work.
- Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): cw_undo_redo_availability (l.50) pairs 'unavailable' with 'Undo becomes available' / 'Redo becomes available' and 'Fails ... if the app has no visible Undo and Redo controls'; cw_unsaved_marker (l.59) pairs 'no unsaved-changes indication' with 'Fails if no unsaved indication appears after the edit'.
- Gates: cw_custom_document_surface types a word and locates where it is displayed before applying the 'not a textarea/input/contenteditable' test; cw_shared_saved_record is entirely positive. tests/scoring.toml '[floors] functional = 0.05' with both gates means an app that cannot be typed into or cannot save earns reward 0 regardless of polish.

Weak-app probes tried on paper: (1) dead Run: every runtime criterion fails at its control. (2) Dead Save: stale-save, history and live-update criteria fail at their control Saves. (3) App that refuses every draft containing the words eval/Function: fails the harmless control. (4) App with permanently disabled Undo/Redo or a marker that never shows: fails the 'becomes available' / 'appears' legs. Conforming-alternative probe: a canvas editor or a static restored picture is not failed by any control.

Non-blocking observations (not defects of this row, recorded for the owner):
(a) cw_focus_returns_to_code (polish l.41) requires an effect only for Replace all ('a Replace all that changed something'); the Format, Undo, Redo and Save legs do not say the action must have done anything, so toolbar buttons that never take focus and do nothing satisfy four of five legs. It is a positive focus check, still needs working typing and Replace all, and is worth at most 1/6 of polish.
(b) cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus (polish l.23) counts only controls 'the app offers and that is enabled' and says 'A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere', so it has no minimum set; the gates guarantee at least an editor, Save and a library exist.
(c) cw_stop_cancels_pending_work uses a control that fires 'about two seconds after Run' while the suppressed write is 'about four seconds after Run'; the delays are not identical, though cw_newer_run_supersedes and cw_output_before_failure_kept exercise four-second timers.
(d) cw_history_restore_retry lets the judge 'leave this one step out without failing' when the restore cannot be recorded and no retry control exists, and only asks to 'note the status of the reply'; a malformed replay that is rejected would look like deduplication. The criterion does require replaying 'with its method, path, headers and body'.
(e) cw_preview_isolation says the hostile marker 'must not appear ... in the library' but no listed probe tries to write the library; the leg is redundant with the fetch-must-reject leg rather than exploitable.
(f) The task's gates/constraints/prompt.md dropped the template sentence 'A negative check requires its stated positive control'; it keeps 'if a step could not be performed say so plainly and fail that criterion', and the one negative gate criterion has its own typed-word control.
